$comment: Curated PostgreSQL extensions Opfield offers (the single source of truth; the docker daemon embeds it and refuses every other name, the controller keeps an identical copy). delivery: contrib = in the official image, baked = in Opfield's image (packages/daemons/postgres-image/image/baked.list), bundle = downloaded into the database's volume. bundle names the bundle an extension needs (its own, or a dependency such as postgis for h3_postgis). preloadLibraries lists the shared_preload_libraries entries it needs; their load order and the settings the daemon adds with them are in preloadLibraries at the top level. Bump allowlistVersion with every change.
